findings.description: r-6 adrs omits ADR-SAG-0019; r-6 hashes the exact wire body, which that ADR separates from the canonical payload digest. Disposition R6-ARCH-001 claims 0019 is listed.
findings.remediation: Add ADR-SAG-0019 to the r-6 adrs list with the reason: request_sha256 is the wire-body digest, prompt_sha256 stays the canonical-payload digest.

findings.description: r-6 adrs omits ADR-SAG-0012; the ADR-SAG-0026 r-6 amendment (architecture.md:1269) relies on it still holding.
findings.remediation: Add ADR-SAG-0012 to the r-6 adrs list: hashing the carried bytes in sc-agent-http is not Jev semantics, sc-jev untouched.

findings.description: r-7 adrs omits ADR-SAG-0024; r-7 owns RunConfig::models (owned_paths line 125).
findings.remediation: Add ADR-SAG-0024 to the r-7 adrs list: RunConfig::models(ModelAliases), prepare/run entry unchanged.

findings.description: r-7 adrs omits ADR-SAG-0012; r-7 edits sc-jev check.rs and client/mod.rs, adds fn model_id, and removes the jev.toml model key.
findings.remediation: Add ADR-SAG-0012 to the r-7 adrs list: Jev model pin moves to the catalog, sc-jev still owns every Jev operation.

findings.description: r-7 adrs omits ADR-SAG-0006; r-7 owns HttpRequest::with_trace in sc-agent-http (line 102).
findings.remediation: Add ADR-SAG-0006 to the r-7 adrs list: HttpRequest gains an optional SendTrace, Transport trait unchanged.
